card.name: Digits inside retail price figures
card.fires_on: Digits 9 or 5 and the decimal point inside dollar prices such as $9.99, US$399.99 or $19.99, mostly in product cost lists. Also fires on a few unrelated words like 'sell' or 'the' in 'Save the Children'.

modes.label: Digits in prices
modes.description: The 9 or the point inside a dollar price ending in .99, often in launch-price tables or cost lines.

modes.label: Selling and charity names
modes.description: Scattered words about selling or in a charity name, outside prices.
